$comment: The executable half of the 2026-09 documentation audit: every figure the docs publish in prose - README first screen, hero image footer, badges, the usage guide, the store kit and the permissions doc - has a command that recomputes it from committed data (package.json, the lockfile, seed-rules.json, src/shared/constants.ts, the source and the test tree), run by .github/workflows/claims.yml through alloevil/verify-claims. A doc edit that contradicts the code now fails the gate. Claims a command cannot settle carry check.manual with the receipt they do need - eight of them: the classification cascade, the memory figure being an estimate rather than a measurement, the live proxy route, undo, hibernation, dedup, Chrome's own on-device AI requirements and the Chrome 151 unpacked-load observation. CHANGELOG.md is deliberately out of scope: its history ('grew from 57 to 390', 'was documented as Chrome 127+') describes past releases and is true as written.

The unit tests cover the pure pieces (rule matching, duplicate grouping, formatting) - not the cascade.
